messages:
carmen: Hi all — got married abroad in January and trying to add my spouse. The municipality issued a digital certificate but the apostille backlog is long. Any guidance on international docs and whether I can get retro coverage?

maya-hr: Congrats Carmen! :tada: We can accept consular/embassy certification OR the original foreign certificate plus a certified English translation. If apostille is delayed, a consular stamp and evidence of appointment or submission helps.

carmen: I missed the standard 30-day QLE window due to the backlog. Is there any flexibility?

maya-hr: Yes. Standard QLE is 30 days, but for documented international processing delays we allow up to 60 days for submission of supporting docs. Retro coverage (back to the marriage date) can be considered up to 90 days with manager + HR approval and good supporting evidence.

carmen: Thanks. How will payroll handle premiums if we set a retro start?

leo-payroll: If HR sets the coverage retro to the marriage date, payroll will apply retroactive deduction adjustments on the next payroll run after enrollment is finalized. That usually takes 1-2 pay periods and will show as a balancing item. If it creates a refund or additional deduction we’ll notify you via payroll@redwood.ai.

carmen: Preferred way to submit docs? Portal or email?

maya-hr: Use the benefits portal so the files attach to your case: Benefits Portal -> My Open Requests -> Add Dependent -> Upload Documents. If you must email, send to benefits@redwood.ai with subject: "QLE docs - Carmen" and we9ll transfer them into the portal.

carmen: I only have a Spanish PDF plus a local translator can provide a certified translation but not notarized. Will that be OK?

maya-hr: Certified translation from a recognized service is fine. If notarization isn9t available, include the consular stamp and any appointment or submission receipts. Those docs strengthen the case for the extended window.

carmen: Cool. Anything I should note on the portal submission?

maya-hr: Add: "Marriage abroad 01-[marriage date] 02-Delayed apostille; submitting consular-stamped certificate + certified translation; requesting retro coverage." That flag routes to the right reviewer.

hr-bot: Ticket #PO-2024-1867 created and assigned to maya-hr. Upload link DM9d to Carmen.

tom-manager: Happy to sign off for retro coverage pending doc verification. Please loop me once docs are uploaded.

maya-hr: Thanks Tom. Carmen 56 once you upload I56ll confirm receipt and then we56ll coordinate payroll. Expect a confirmation email within 3 business days after upload. :thumbsup:
